name: comp-101
blurb: Bookmark icon that toggles color and shows contextual tooltip on hover.
description: A Toggle component wrapping a bookmark icon that changes color and background on press. Includes a tooltip that updates text based on bookmark state.
use_when: Marking items as favorites with visual feedback and a helpful tooltip hint.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where tooltips cannot show, or when hardcoded colors conflict with theme.
a11y: Uses aria-label for the toggle button and aria-hidden for the icon. Tooltip provides state-dependent text for screen readers.
